# Davy Keith

## Overview

- **Age:** 10 years old  <sub>[v2 c16 P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 c22 P1](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0001), [v3 c3 P1](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0001), [v3 c28 P4](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0004)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v2 c8 P10](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0010)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v3 c5 P17](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0017)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Davy-boy  <sub>[v3 c22 P23](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0023)</sub>

## Appearance

Davy is a handsome little lad with a round head covered in fuzzy yellow ringlets, roguish elf-like eyes, and a snub nose. He has a single dimple in one cheek, which gives him a comical, lopsided look when he laughs.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c8 P33](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0033), [v2 c20 P8](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0008), [v2 c25 P71](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0071)_

## Personality

Davy possesses a lively curiosity and is constantly asking inquisitive questions. Lacking a particle of imagination, he is thoroughly practical and mindlessly heedless or forgetful at times. Though once a terror full of mischief and disobedient impulses, he has a natural knack for winning love and is easily comforted by food.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c14 P30](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0030), [v2 c16 P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 c18 P3](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0003), [v2 c25 P41](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0041), [v4 c4 P7](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0007)_

## Goals

- wants to live to be a hundred years old  <sub>[v3 c14 P43](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0043)</sub>

## History

Following his mother's death, Davy and his twin sister Dora were taken in by Marilla Cuthbert at Green Gables. Initially a terror for mischief who often got into trouble, he grew devoted to Anne Shirley and slowly reformed under her and Marilla's care. He started attending Avonlea school alongside his desk mate Milty Boulter, continuously asking endless questions about the world and theology. Over the years, he developed into a smart lad who helped around Green Gables while maintaining a rivalrous edge with Milty over his height.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c7 P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 c8 P33](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0033), [v2 c14 P30](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0030), [v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 c26 P31](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0031), [v3 c40 P6](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0006), [v4 c4 P7](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0007)_
